Thank you to the incredible witnesses who spoke at my seventh Kidnapped and Disappeared immigration hearing.

I will continue hosting these hearings to lift up the brave voices speaking out against the cruelty and devastation of Trump’s immigration crackdown.

Video
This is great news! It is time that the rich pay their fair share, and I’m so glad that my home state of Washington is leading the way. seattletimes.com/seattle-new…

INSANE. This would be the biggest defense budget in modern history.

The Pentagon is the only agency that has NEVER passed an audit. Plus just the other day, Trump said we can’t pay for childcare because “we’re fighting wars.” ENOUGH. We can not keep funding these illegal wars.

Great news! I’ve officially re-introduced the Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act to make sure the ultra-rich pay their fair share.

Our tax system needs urgent reform — this is an important step to address wealth inequality and level the playing field for working people.

Video

At my immigration hearing, Marion Donovan-Kaloust detailed her experience working with unaccompanied children and the horrors they’ve seen under Trump. 

No child should have to go through this cruelty. It must end now.

Video

Trump’s illegal war in Iran isn’t just driving up the cost of gas. Soon enough, we will see it in the cost of our groceries.

Americans don’t want this. Trump must end this war immediately. kuow.org/stories/washington-…

AG Bondi called apologizing to the Epstein survivors getting into the “gutter." Good riddance.

Video
Under Republicans, there’s always money for war, but nothing to actually help American families.
1 year since “liberation day” and the American people are continuing to get screwed over by the Trump administration.

Detention, family separation, and ICE’s attacks on our neighbors have serious impacts on our kids.

Pediatrician Dr. Tania Caballero details the short and long-term medical and psychological consequences of Trump’s immigration crackdown on children and families.

Video
Chag Pesach Sameach! Wishing all those who celebrate a meaningful Passover spent with family and friends.

Trump incited an insurrection on January 6th, 2021. With a new ruling in our case, Lee v. Trump, we are one step closer to holding him accountable.

We cannot stop pushing for justice. My full statement:

Republicans want to reestablish the China Initiative — a failed program that actually did very little to protect our national security and instead stoked anti-Asian hate.

Restarting this failed initiative would just exacerbate that racism and xenophobia.

Video

Trump wants to decide who can vote by mail, despite the fact that HE voted by mail in a recent election.

He knows his wars and reckless policies that are skyrocketing prices are unpopular, so he’s trying to rig the next election. It’s illegal and must be challenged in court. cnn.com/2026/03/31/politics/…

You’re so close. Now say it again, but replace “Iran” with the “United States.”


AF Post (@AFpost)

State Sec. Rubio: “Imagine if instead of spending billions on weapons, Iran spent that money on its people. They’d have a much different country.”

Follow: @AFpost

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/AFpost/status/2038833286580257218#m

Today, the Supreme Court is hearing oral arguments on Trump's executive order to eliminate birthright citizenship.

The president does not get to decide who is a citizen on a whim — the Constitution does.

It's simple: if you’re born in the United States, you’re a citizen.

Kids should be focused on going to school and playing with their friends, not living in fear that their parents will be kidnapped by ICE.

Listen to Nicole Isern’s heartbreaking testimony about how Trump’s cruelty has impacted the kids and families she works with.

Video

Republicans introduced a bill that is a thinly veiled attempt to give Trump unlimited power to use the DOJ as his own personal law firm. 
 
Congress must start enforcing our checks and balances — not hand him even more power.

Video
